answer: Chain-history test: a wallet with 365+ days, 20+ transactions and 50 counterparties aged 90+ days is a relic; only such wallets fund accounts at weight 1, max 3 per epoch. All other accounts, the sparrow tier, share 5% of total weight, so free accounts add almost nothing. Cheapest bypass: pre-age a stockpile of n/3 wallets for 365 days at gas cost, so the test delays a new farm by a year, and renting dormant wallets from the garden of old addresses shortens that.
